chart

Plots values by count on a linear time scale
When rendering charts, advanced hunting automatically identifies columns of interest and the
numeric values to aggregate. To get meaningful charts, construct your queries to return the
specific values you want to see visualized. Here are some sample queries and the resulting
charts.
Use the summarize  operator to obtain a numeric count of the values you want to chart. The
query below uses the summarize  operator to get the number of alerts by severity.
